answer: Make identity cost capital that cannot be pooled: each new agent must anchor a glacier stake that unlocks only a sliver per epoch, so a thousand puppets freeze a thousand deposits for months instead of paying one flat fee. Attestation then needs a beacon puzzle seeded per identity and settled in nectar per solve, so clone farms cannot share one solution across clones. Cloning costs near-linearly in locked capital and compute; an honest agent pays once.
